title: Nalain rakh dena
body:
Nalain rakh dena
<<MINI>>
Tu aye taqdeer taaje azmat e kaunain rakh dena..(2)
Tu aye taqdeer taaje azmat e kaunain rakh dena
Mere sar par mere sarkaar ki nalain rakh dena
<<DIVIDER>>
Ilahi dekhlu mai bhi to abru e Mohammad ko..(2)
Meri aankhein zara qausain ke mabain rakh dena
Kaha Allah ne qausain kab hadd hai Mohammad ki..(2)
Jaha'n ye aap ruk jaye wahi qausain rakh dena
<<DIVIDER>>
Azeezo saath mere izzate darain rakh dena..(2)
Kafan ke saath mein khaak e dare hasnain rakh dena
Jo hai qur'aano itrat se gara palla do aalam ka..(2)
To is naat mein ek qafiya saqlain rakh dena
<<DIVIDER>>
Farishte jab mere amaal ke baare mein kuch puche..(2)
To unke aage naat e sarwar e kaunain rakh dena
Sarosh aankhein teri arshe bari ki sair kar lengi..(2)
Tu inko zere paaye sahib e kausain rakh dena
<<MINI>>
Mere sar par mere sarkaar ki nalain rakh dena
Tu aye taqdeer taaje azmat e kaunain rakh dena
Mere sar par mere sarkaar ki nalain rakh dena
author: Farhan Ali
